description: TopicMeta with no durability declared (empty). The byte-identical-to-pre-revision case: a producer predating the revision carries the empty string, which is how every existing TopicMeta (e.g. the fountain recording's discovery announce) reads under APPENDABLE.
exercises: 1.8-revision TopicMeta.durability absent (empty string) — a pre-revision producer
the empty durability serializes and round-trips as an ordinary empty string
